payout_rules: 100% performance-based ($0 upfront spend): commissions are calculated on net collected product revenue (excluding shipping & tax) only after the customer's Stripe payment succeeds and clears.
14-day settlement lock: payouts release 14 days post-fulfillment to protect against canceled orders, size exchanges, or chargebacks.
Dual attribution: sales are credited whenever a buyer uses your referral URL (?ref=CODE) OR enters your club promo code at checkout.
Self-sustaining unit economics: even with a 10% customer discount + 15% affiliate payout, Apex Hybrid maintains a 23%–41% positive net margin across every apparel bundle and hardware SKU.

payment_links_architecture.storefront_checkout_flow: All 72 SKUs in catalog.json use `https://www.apexhybridco.com/?buy={SKU}` and the storefront cart drawer (`app.js`), which binds `stripe_account_id` (`acct_1UUaY9Rut88O8nG2`), `stripe_product_id`, and `stripe_price_id` into the instant order reservation & Stripe invoice/payment dispatch flow.
payment_links_architecture.promotion_code_support: Enabled across both the main storefront (`/?promo=CODE`) and `/team_orders.html` interactive checkout calculator (`DOUBLES10`, `CLUB10`, `HYROX10`, `TEAM15`, `GYM20`), backed by active Stripe Coupons `APEX_CLUB_10` (10% off), `APEX_TEAM_15` (15% off), and `APEX_GYM_20` (20% off).
